name: US Total Market Index ETF (Wealth Accumulation)

yield.notes: Dividend yield only shown here. Total return (7-10% historically) excluded — this is a wealth stream, not a cash-flow stream. Use SWR plan for income.

flags: Primary use: wealth accumulation, not immediate cash flow
Short-term volatility: S&P 500 drawdowns of 20-50% are normal
Cash flow only if selling shares per SWR plan (4% rule)

prerequisites: Brokerage account (Fidelity, Vanguard, Schwab, or Robinhood)
startup_checklist: Open brokerage account if you don't have one (Fidelity or Vanguard recommended)
Choose fund: VTI (Vanguard), FSKAX (Fidelity), SWTSX (Schwab) — all near-zero expense ratios
Set up automatic monthly investment (dollar-cost averaging)
Enable dividend reinvestment (DRIP) to compound returns
Ignore short-term price movements — review allocation annually only
failure_modes: Panic-selling during market correction locks in losses
Treating this as cash-flow stream leads to selling at wrong time
kill_criteria: Cash flow emergency forces selling at market low
Better long-term vehicle identified (unlikely for most investors)
sources_note: Dividend yields from ETF provider data. Historical returns from Morningstar.
